about_the_game:
《Forward: Demo》 - FREE to Suffer! Taste the Mouse-Controlled Physics Hell!
Your mouse is your LIFE – swing it without shame!

Want a preview of the tear-and-laugh physics torture in the full game? The FREE demo is your "Starter Torture Kit"!

In this "kind-hearted" teaser, ditch the keyboard—your mouse is the only savior (or killer). Drag, swing, and fling your floppy (or rigid?) hero body with the cursor...

Brace for the pain: One slip sends you spiraling skyward, free-falling, or stuck in absurd corners pondering life’s meaning... Absurd deaths guarantee desk-slamming laughter or stunned silence...

But! Watching your desperate struggles, that addictive agony-to-ecstasy magic kicks in. Reach the end BY ANY MEANS! Roll on, future Mouse Hero!

Clearing the demo’s climax will make you scream—"GIVE ME MORE PAIN!" That’s Forward’s cult appeal!

DOWNLOAD FREE NOW to begin your "Pain-to-Bliss" initiation! <<<
